mynta Iah baa ong ba ka ia kynthup tut ia ki bynta baroh 
kiba hap bad ia snob bad ka (Literature). Ngim duna 
shuh ha ka liang ka ^ ’Lexicography’, ka 

'Philosophy', ka ‘Mythology’, ka Fiction’ ka History,

XMe’. Wat ha ka liang ka Sonnet hi ruh ngim sah

ha ka ‘Epk*. 

Ka long kaht shai bad in tip paitbah solonsar Im

iaid lew bba, Kane ka long kaei kaei ka haa idam

taba sbab teb lakam tang ba kawet ka bynta jong ka thob 
ka tar. Ka long kaba shisha ba ym don ba pule hi rub 
ia ki kot Khasi kiba mih, khamtam lei let ia ki kot ‘Poetry* 
lymda dei kito kiba la ‘prescribed* ba ka ‘Syllabus*. 
Kane rub ka long ka raibi kaba ngi dei ban pynduhnob 
lada ngi kwah ba ka thph ka tar Khasi kan kiew ^aphrang 
bad ka jaitbynriew kan roi irat. Uwei na ki ‘Critic’ u la 
kdew lypa kham mypsbwa . . .. “Stagnation is death,

activity is life. If Khasi literature, is to thrive and not 
only to survive, it is most essential to see that the books 
published are not left to themselves to reach the public. 
Such has been the case hitherto and that is why their 
covetrge has been very limited. The incipient inspira* 
tion of the creative artist is not likely to wax without 
the incentive of a widening circle of appreciative readers 
of his creation . , . under such circumstances, it is more 
likely to wilt and wither away’’ . . . Kawei na ki daw, lehse, 
ka long kumba ong u Dr. S. K. Bbuyan ‘ Love of litera- 
ture and love of the past are not to be generally found 
among the educated section of the Khasi community. 
They have been allured by the charms of the culture with 
which they have come in contact and never perceived that 
there is good in their own . . .’* Bad dei na katei ka daw 
ruh kumba ong u Prof. I. M. Simon . . . "dei tang ka 
jingieit ia ka mynnor kaba lab ban plie ia ka lad ba 
ngin dang iohi ia ka iawei kaba pynhun bad kaba jlan." 
Nangta u ong shuh sbuh ba "Lymda ngim kyndit byn- 
riew . . . ki pateng ki ban dang wan kin long kiba la dkul 
ka jingiasob bad ka mynnor ; ym shuh ki Khasi, bynrei 
ki Nongsah ha ki lum Khasi, kiba long kiwei pat ki 
jaitbynriew.'* Hynrei ngim dei pat ban duh jingkyrmen 
kumba ong. U Dr. H. W. Sten, ‘‘Katba ka jaitb^mriew 
Khasi ka dang sah ha sla pyrthei ka ktien Khasi (Ka 
thoh ka tar)r uh ka dang neb." Ngi im ba kane ka Ri kaba 
fiewspah shisha ha ka poitri. Bad dei na kane ka daw 
imat ba u Fr. H. Elias (Bam kwai ha dwar U Blei) u ong 
. . . *‘Ka Ri Khasi, dei ka Ri jong ka Poitri." Ngi ia 
kubur Mta bad katei ka jingkynthoh ; namar, kumba 
shu kdew nongmuna, lada u Keats, tang da kaba peit 
bad ioU ia ki jingthobdur ba a *Uro,* u lab ban thoh ia

kato ka *'Ode to a Grecian Urn" ba pawnam ha ka 
‘English Literature" katno tarn ia ngi lei lei kiba im ha 
kane ka ri kaba ker sawdong da ka poitri suda. Kata 
ki lum, ki wab, ki kshatd, ki riat kt ram, ki syntiew 
ki skud, ki klilaw ki btap, ki mrad, ki mreng, ki 
dieng ki siej, ki krem, ki pubon ki mawbynna, kt riew 
khraw ba ia khlad nob. wat ki jinglong ka Mariang bad 
bun kiwei pat kiba ngim tab ban niewtang lut hangne, 
kiba kbam phylla bad pawnam ban ia kiwei pat kt ri ka 
pyrthei lab ban ong. Ngi lab da kaba jem ban pynwan 
ia ki ha ki kyntien bad lain ba kordor jong ka poitri bad 
ban pynmih rub kita ki *Ode', ki ‘Elegy' kt ‘Sonnet’, 
bad wat la kt Epic hi rub kiba donnam kum ki jong kiwei 
pat ; tang iada ngi la kloi ban shim ia la u khulom 
bad ka kot sada bad pynleit iaiade ha ka jingjar jar jong 
ka mied ha kaba ngi iait na kino kino ki huri hura. 
Dei katei ka ‘Ode’ jong u Keat ba la jer haneng kaba la 
pynlong rub ia nga ban pynmih ia ki artyili kt *Ode’. 
Ka long kaba shisha ba lymda ngi pule ia ka ‘Literature’ 
jong kiwei pat ki ri khamtam jong kito kiba la iaid sba- 
phrang ngin ym lah ban tip baduh katno ka-Ia-jong 
ka la roi. 

Nga ia kubur bad u Dr. H. W Sten ba ka poitri 
ka mih na ka jingsngew, namar lymda u Myllung ne u 
Nongthoh u don kata ka jingsngew ha ka mynsiem kum 
ka kamram jong u ba aiu un leh na ka bynta ka Ri 
bad ka jaidbynriew, ki jingtrei bad jingmut jmgpyrkhat 
jong u kin long tang ha sla, kum ki palong sabon kiba 
tang sbu mih shabar bad dei Iyer ki la jab nob. Tangba 
kawei ngi dei ban kynmaw ba kane ka juk mynta kara 
pdiang shuh ia kano kano ka jingthoh kaba madei mata;

kaba khlem da ia nujor ne pynshong nongrim bad tip 
janai ia ki jnit ki jnat (ki rule ki ain) kiba iadei bad 
kata ka jingthoh. Haba nga ong kumne, kam mut pat 
ban pynduh jingkyrmen iano iano, hynrei ba ia kumno 
kumno, ngi dei ban tip aiu ngi thoh bad kaba knomo 
kata Im jingthoh. Ngi sngew ia bap jingmut bad a

the betterment of the society". 

Ha ki bym sngewthuh ia ka dor jong ka 'Poetry* 
ka long kumba bret ia u Mawlynnai ha ki sniang; hynrei 
ha kiba sngewthuh bad tip ia ka dor jong ka pat, 
"Shi dkhot ka poitri u myllung kan thoh shi volume

thew Arnold u la ong ha ka, "The study of poetry"^ 

"More and more mankind will discover that 

we have to turn to poetry to interpret life for us, to 
console us and to sustain us '* 

Nga ngeit skbem ba kine ki kbatwei tylli ki poim 
ki nang kham pynriewspab shnb shuh ia ka Literature

Nga sngewngub shibun ia ka sorkar Meghalaya, kaba 
ia iarop ban bei tyngka ha kaba pynmib ia kine ki jing-

k'.ew irat ha ki sngt ki ban dang wan. 

Sbi kyntien bangne nga kwah ban pynpaw ba kaba 
iadei bad ka ‘Tittle jong kane ka kot, ka ‘Skit Sym- 
phiang’. Kat kum ka jingbatai jong u Fr. H, Elias ka 
skit symphiang ka dei ban kyntliup rub ia ka satire (Ka

ngan sa pynrung pat ha ‘edition’ ne ka sien shon kaba 
ar. Ngam banse ton kdew lypa bangne namar ioh don 
kano kano ka jingujor na ki oongpule bad ki ‘Critic' 
ka thoh ka tar. 

Khatduh nga pan map lypa na phi ki Nongpule 
lada don kano ka bynta ba nga la laid lait bad lada 
don kino kino ki jingbakla spel ne shon ha kane ka kot. 

Sa sbi kyntien nga sngewngub ia u Blei uba la ai 
lad ba ngan pyndep ia kine ki jingtbob bad nga kyrmen 
ba un dang ailad ban pyndep ia ki jingtbob kiba dang sab.
